name: D12 TAIFEX option-surface input clock/rate/forward contract

quoteClock.rule: The daily file's last best bid/ask values do not carry synchronized quote timestamps. Treat them as end-state replay observations, not simultaneous executable quotes.

expiryClock.payoffWindow: 13:00(exclusive)-13:25(inclusive) index observations plus final closing index on final settlement day
expiryClock.nominalModelExpiryClock: 13:30 Asia/Taipei on ordinary final trading/settlement day
expiryClock.settlementPublicationClock: final settlement price announced before 14:00 under ordinary domestic-index workflow
expiryClock.exceptionRule: Market interruption/closing-delay exceptions require explicit source state; otherwise UNKNOWN rather than silent nominal-clock substitution.

forwardConvention.monthlyPrimary: Same-expiry TX regular-session final best-bid/ask midpoint from the same source date.
forwardConvention.parityCrossCheck: Parity-derived F from eligible TXO Call/Put midpoint pairs may be used as QA only.
forwardConvention.prohibited: Do not use the rejected joint parity F+D estimator as the default weekly forward/discount method.

discountRateConvention.taifexGuidance: TAIFEX theoretical-price guidance requires an explicit annual risk-free rate and notes bank time-deposit or commercial-paper rates as common examples.

officialSensitivityProxy.name: CBC central-bank CD issue-rate term points
officialSensitivityProxy.guard: CBC CD rates are not silently relabeled as the unique true risk-free curve. They are an official PIT-known sensitivity proxy until bank-deposit/commercial-paper or another justified primary convention is frozen.

modelState.dividendCarry: When a futures forward is used, carry/dividend semantics must be explicit and must not be double-counted.

h11Rule: D12-07 simple skew/term baseline must be built before D12-16 residual surface factors on identical eligible rows/common support.
exactNext: Resolve an official decision-time-valid primary rate/discount convention and tenor mapping.
Then run IV inversion on the same monthly parent under frozen forward/rate/clock inputs.
Run the official CBC-CD curve only as a predeclared sensitivity comparator, not as a post-hoc winner.
Compare D12-07 simple skew/term against D12-16 residual level/slope/curvature before outcomes.
